feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Incumbent Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts' Democratic primary for US Senate
entry.summary: Bucking a push for younger leadership this election season, Sen. Ed Markey, 80, won the Democratic nomination against Rep. Seth Moulton, 47, who said that his party needed new leaders.

entry.title: North Carolina Rep. Chuck Edwards is formally censured over harassment allegations
entry.summary: The censure vote drew bipartisan support, and followed an investigation by the House Ethics Committee into allegations of sexual harassment against two young female staff members.

entry.title: Trump's pro-data center stance is putting pressure on Republicans ahead of midterms
entry.summary: Trump's pro-data center stance is out of step with voters. Republicans are trying to navigate the issue but it's putting them at odds with the president's AI agenda.

entry.title: Congress averts a government shutdown ahead of the midterms
entry.summary: With just a few weeks to spare, the House approved legislation extending funding through mid-December.

entry.title: ICE says it has enough body cameras now, after series of deadly shootings
entry.summary: Cameras could help alleviate some concerns about ICE transparency and accountability after immigration officers were involved in over two dozen shootings under the Trump administration.

entry.title: USPS 'carefully reviewing' whistleblower claim on plan for Trump's mail in voting order
entry.summary: A whistleblower says the U.S. Postal Service is rushing out an online system for President Trump's push to restrict mail voting that could "derail" the midterm election if courts allow it to proceed.

entry.title: Judge rules man accused in Charlie Kirk murder case will stand trial, facing possible death penalty
entry.summary: Utah District Judge Tony Graf heard arguments over evidence introduced in July, to decide whether there was enough probable cause for a trial in the shooting of the conservative activist last year.

entry.title: Affordability is the centerpiece of Democrats' message in Pennsylvania swing district
entry.summary: A rematch in a swing district Pennsylvania is showcasing how Republican messaging from 2024 is getting a replay, this time from Democratic candidates.

entry.title: In Massachusetts, Sen. Ed Markey and Rep. Seth Moulton vie for Senate nomination
entry.summary: Sen. Ed Markey faces Congressman Seth Moulton in the Massachusetts Senate primary. Both candidates have similar progressive platforms.

entry.title: Trump officials cut political interference ban after unusual Census Bureau report
entry.summary: After the Census Bureau issued a report tied to a Trump-aligned think tank, the bureau's parent agency cut language banning political interference from its scientific integrity policy, NPR learned.
